Sept. 10 Mary L. Feldmann - 47 - heart trouble ... family trouble worse Elsie Hope - 23 - wayword.
June Van Wert of Bay City - 16 - cancer like groth very threatening. Oct. 10 .... improved !... But ?... Enrolled To-day 5.00
13 Nicholas Kobane - 20 - shot accidently - six months ago. Still very low and ... "in ballence.
Thomas Carney - 7 - cross-eyed since a year ago - was at show Bracken (John) - Plymouth, heart, stomach, etc Hattie Swider - 45 - inward cancer ... has three children .. ...
Mrs. Doherty - Maryvill -
Page 75 Sept. 14 Ronald Stephen McDougall - 7 - when a year old was given up by special- ists - who said he'd never walk or talk. He does both perfectly .... but is slow mentally. Enrolled To-day as perpetual member.
Sept. 21 Mrs. Emma Dawson - 49 - Lutheran - Ezema ...
16 Antonio D'Angelo -61 - helpless with arthritis and almost hopeless .... 8 months since last holy Communion.
John James Maul - 25 - drinking - staying out till morning .... Michael O'Connor - 68 - inward cancer very threatening - in fact not at all expected to live - except by miracle ... Enrolled once more To- night - 3rd or 4th perpetual.
17 Ora M. Peterson of Jackson, Mich. - 61 - palsey very nerveous ... four years in this condition - never baptized ... Wife a Catholic invalid 10 yrs. Enrolls self To-day.
20 S'd Trombly - 61 - blood-clott and gangreenous foot - fear broken blood vessel - enrolled this a.m. Drs. say only a miracle will save leg. Enrolled To-day 21st $5.
Page 76 Sept. 20 Michael Brusco - 34 - operation for sinus ... anxious.
